solutionSql:
SELECT w.city AS city,
       COUNT(e.id)::integer AS events
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN routes r ON r.origin_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.route_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN shipment_events e ON e.shipment_id = s.id
GROUP BY w.city
ORDER BY w.city;
notes: Each origin city has events in the sample: Valehaven 228, Mossreach 219, Reedford 120 and Cloudmere 111, which totals the 678 shipment_events rows. Counting COUNT(e.id) after the joins counts events, not shipments.
